# function: proton_service_template_version

Builds the ARN for `proton` `service-template-version`:

```
arn:${Partition}:proton:${Region}:${Account}:service-template/${TemplateName}:${MajorVersion}.${MinorVersion}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:proton:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:service-template/template-name:major-version.minor-version
output "proton_service_template_version" {
  value = provider::arn::proton_service_template_version("template-name", "major-version", "minor-version")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
proton_service_template_version(template_name string, major_version string, minor_version string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `template_name` (String) Value for `${TemplateName}` in the ARN template.
1. `major_version` (String) Value for `${MajorVersion}` in the ARN template.
1. `minor_version` (String) Value for `${MinorVersion}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
